visualCharacteristics.summary: AMAG garage finder: interactive map, search + filter panel, garage list with detail modals, off-canvas filters and a "Directly to" pill
visualCharacteristics.purpose: AMAG garage finder (store locator): an interactive OpenStreetMap (Leaflet) with one AMAG marker per garage (authored map captures stay as placeholder until tiles load), a search field that filters the garage list and markers client-side, a filter trigger opening the off-canvas filter panel (type, brands, offers, counter/confirm/cancel), the garage list (name, address, brands, call and route links) where a garage or marker click opens its detail modal (address, call/contact/route/website links, rating badge iframe, sale/service brand chips, primary appointment CTA) and centers the map on it, and a "Directly to" quick-links pill shown from scrollY 300. One self-contained interactive block; the state is the DOM

A garage row and its details row pair by name, repeated names in order (fallback: order). Garage coordinates and service brands come from garage-data.js, not from the authored content
